title: Tool-binding JSON parameter interop, validation rules, and runtime error taxonomy
creator: Maya Chen
description: Define a single interoperable JSON schema format and runtime validation contract for tool/function calling that balances strict correctness with graceful backward compatibility. Includes: schema metadata versioning, parameter coercion policy, error classification (user vs internal vs transient), streaming partial-success semantics, and a mapping from validation failures to user-facing error strings and internal error codes.
acceptance_criteria: A clear JSON schema format documented in Confluence with examples for primitives, objects, arrays, enums, and optional fields.
Runtime validates parameters against schema and returns deterministic error codes + human-readable messages for all validation failures.
Compatibility layer supports schema versioning with documented downgrade/fallback behavior and automatic coercion rules for common mismatches.
Streaming tool calls can emit structured partial validation errors (warnings) vs terminal errors; SDKs can surface these consistently.
Unit and integration tests cover 95% of validation branches and compatibility downgrade scenarios.
proposed_solution: Introduce a compact schema header that includes 'schema_version' and 'compat_level' metadata. Validation runs in three phases: (1) coercion phase applying candidate, safe coercions (e.g., string -> number only when explicit 'coerce_numbers' is enabled); (2) structural validation phase producing categorized errors; (3) post-validation enrichment phase producing suggested fixes. Error objects emitted by the runtime will be normalized to {code, severity, message, path, suggestion} where code is stable (e.g., TOOL_SCHEMA_TYPE_MISMATCH), severity in [info, warning, error], and suggestion is optional free-text. Streaming responses will interleave normal tool output with 'validation.warning' events for nonfatal issues. We will maintain a compatibility map for legacy schema aliases and provide an opt-in 'strict_mode' that converts warnings to errors.
engineering_notes: Initial spike showed ~3ms median extra latency for validation on 2kB payloads when using streaming validation; acceptable for P1.
Decision: prefer deterministic stable codes so clients can route logic; avoid ad-hoc free-text-only errors.
Trade-off: aggressive coercion reduces user friction but can silently change intent. Default is conservative (no coercion) and enable opt-in per-customer or per-call flag.
Implementation plan: add validate_params(schema, params, opts) -> list<error-string> + warnings; then runtime maps to canonical error records before emitting over API/stream.
Edge case: large nested objects may produce many path errors; we will cap errors returned to N=10 and include a 'truncated_count' field as string to keep schema flat.
testing_plan: Property-based tests to generate thousands of mismatched shapes and assert stable code assignment.
Integration tests with SDKs verifying streaming 'validation.warning' interleaving and back-compat behavior when compat_level downgraded.
Regression tests for previously failing ticket ENG-37120 (ambiguity in enum coercion).
Load test: validate 10k requests/s on a single runtime worker; observe p95 validation overhead.
rollout_plan: Feature-flagged behind 'tool_schema_v1' config. Start in canary region with internal customers for 2 weeks, then enable for new customers, and finally coerce existing customers via opt-in before full flip. Add server-side telemetry for error codes and warning rates to detect impact.

example_error_catalog: TOOL_SCHEMA_MISSING_FIELD - error - 'Missing required parameter "user_id" at path /user'
TOOL_SCHEMA_TYPE_MISMATCH - error - 'Expected integer but got string at path /items/0/quantity'
TOOL_SCHEMA_ENUM_INVALID - error - 'Value "fast" is not in allowed set ["low","medium","high"] at path /priority'
TOOL_SCHEMA_COERCION_APPLIED - info - 'Coerced string "42" -> number at path /timeout; enable strict_mode to reject'
TOOL_SCHEMA_STRUCT_TOO_DEEP - warning - 'Object exceeds max depth 20 at path /metadata; truncated for validation'
TOOL_SCHEMA_TRUNCATED_ERRORS - info - 'Returned 10 errors and truncated 5 more; set debug=true to retrieve all'
comments: 2025-02-11 Maya Chen: Spike complete. Found 3 common mismatch patterns from customer logs: numeric-in-strings, dash-casing vs snake_casing, and omitted optional arrays. See spike notes in design doc.
2025-02-12 Arjun Patel: Pushed initial validation library prototype to runtime branch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtimes/pull/6123. Needs API surface review for error shape.
2025-02-14 Lena Ortiz (Design): Reviewed error UX. Requesting that suggestions be short and action-oriented. Example suggestion: 'Send integer or enable coerce=true'.
2025-02-15 Security (Rajiv Kumar): Flagged potential info leak via long validation messages for PII fields. Action: redact values in messages and include only path and type mismatch.
